name: Pradhan Mantri Adi Adarsh Gram Yojana (PMAAGY)
benefit: - **Financial Assistance:** ₹20,38,000/- per village for infrastructure gap filling and development activities.  - **Infrastructure Development:** Support for roads, drinking water, sanitation, education, health, and livelihood infrastructure.  - **Village Development Plan (VDP):** Preparation and execution of need-based development plans for selected villages.  - **Convergence Support:** Integrat
_eligibility_text: > **General Eligibility** - The village must have at least 50% Scheduled Tribe (ST) population. - The village must have a population of at least 500 in plain areas; 250 in hilly/tribal areas. - The village must be selected by the State/UT Government based on criteria defined in the guidelines. > **Preference / Priority** - Preference is given to villages with higher ST population concentration. - Priority is given to villages with significant infrastructure gaps.
